name: Nice Côte d'Azur Airport

slots.v: fully coordinated (Level 3): all operations need a slot; business and general aviation slots are requested by the handling agent from the French slot coordinator (COHOR)
slots.quote: Aircraft operators contact their handling agent who is in charge to request airport slots to COHOR.

handling.v: business aviation handling limited to three providers: AviaVIP, Signature Aviation and DC Aviation G-OPS
handling.quote: The number of groundhandlers (FBO) is limited to three service providers.

noise.v: APU use limited to 30 minutes; engines fully shut down on arrival at the KILO parking area
noise.quote: APU use is limited to 30 minutes

runway.v: two parallel runways: 04R/22L, 2,963 m by 45 m (the longest), and 04L/22R, 2,628 m by 45 m

ppr.v: minimum handling is compulsory and must be arranged (PPR) before leaving the departure airport (VFR chart text)
ppr.quote: Minimum handling compulsory PPR before departure from origin AD.

missing: curfew (only in a superseded AIP edition; current edition not read)
notes: French eAIP (SIA) and Légifrance (arrêté of 2 March 2010 on Nice night restrictions) could not be opened. Operator news item (12 Jan 2021) says the northern runway measures 2,420 m; southern runway length not stated, so longest runway not verified. The 'noise' and 'notable' quotes came back paraphrased by the fetch tool (e.g. 'APU use is limited to 30 minutes'); re-check exact wording. The handler licence text on the page dates from 2014-2022 and may be out of date. COHOR page last modified 2 Oct 2026. Do not name companies on the public site (site rule). | 2026-10-27 run: Current SIA eAIP HTML (01 OCT 2026) not openable; ARP, runways and night rule from AIP France AD 2 LFMN (AIRAC AMDT 06/25, 12 JUN 2025) as republished by DIRCAM; location, customs, PPR from the SIA VAC atlas, 01 OCT 2026 edition. The night rule is a ban on noisy aircraft classes only, not a full closure; times are stated in local time. VFR restriction times are UTC winter (SUM -1 HR = same local time, 11:00-14:00 local). Facts from the superseded edition other than runway, location and operator were not used (curfew).
